points: Architected **AgencyHeight**, a Next.js marketplace used by **3,000+ agents**, as a Turborepo monorepo with 10+ shared packages.
Cut bundle size by **30%** and improved Core Web Vitals scores by **46%** versus the legacy platform.
Shipped an LLM feature on the OpenAI and Gemini APIs, and set the standards the team works to: strict TypeScript, Biome, commit conventions, Dockerized builds, PR review and releases.
Built the interactive visualization layer of the **Census Nepal 2021** results portal.
Shipped internal dashboards for the **Municipal Association of Nepal** (293 municipalities) and the World Bank–funded **DGM Nepal** program.
Owned the frontend of Sarang, a travel platform built for low-bandwidth mobile users.
Built conversion-focused marketing sites and custom WordPress themes for construction, real-estate and consultancy clients.
Shipped features for an online document-filling platform and the company website, plus performance and bug fixes.

about: For more than three years I've shipped production web products for teams in the US and Nepal. Today I work remotely for a US insurance company, where I architected the monorepo behind a marketplace used by more than 3,000 agents and set the engineering standards the team follows.
Before that I built public-sector platforms in Nepal, including the national census results portal and dashboards for the Municipal Association of Nepal.
I care about performance, accessibility and owning features end to end. I work AI-first: Claude Code is my main tool, and I review every line it writes.
